text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oooh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After successfully completing her debut
race,
Wonder Acute is... staring blankly
upward, but
not towards the stands.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Rival Racer
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Acute?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Look. Over there...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What a very large television. And we're
on it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean our race was shown in
living
rooms across the country?

text_block_list.name: Rival Racer
text_block_list.text:
No, that's just the trackside view... Only
the
people here at the course get to see
that
footage.

text_block_list.name: Rival Racer
text_block_list.text:
Well, there might be some satellite
channels that
air small races like this
one, but you'd never see it
on national
TV.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho... Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Based on her expression, Wonder Acute
seems
thoroughly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer dear...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was on television, but I also wasn't on
television.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the gist of what she's trying to say,
but I
didn't realize she wanted to be on
TV that badly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If people at home couldn't see me, I
guess that
means...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
People in the hospital wouldn't have
seen me
either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I wanted all the sweet old
folk doing
rehab to see how hard I'm
working.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute wanted her race
to be
seen by those looking for a fresh
start.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To today's race, you mean? Why, no, I
didn't.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They're all working very hard to build
their own
futures, so I didn't want to
pester them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If nobody is able to watch me from afar
right
now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then, it looks like I've got no choice but
to
become more successful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can do that, they'll be able to hear
everyone
shouting "You can do it!" on
their television sets
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to be on national TV, but the
fact is,
it's a lot harder for dirt races to
get big coverage
than it is for turf races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I may only be a novice trainer myself,
but even I
know that much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, as the sun sets over the
racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I've got a really long journey
ahead of
me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might need to hurry up if I want to
actually
reach my destination one day. If
that's the case,
then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute isn't built for making mad
rushes.
Her easygoing nature is one of
her strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's also the reason she can endure
such
intense training. In which case, our
best course of
action is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's good enough?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Then, let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, dearie, I have faith in you.
We'll
figure out the best method
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute wraps up our discussion
with a
gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we set out to build up her
abilities by
running in a lot of races.
